item.title: Houthis step up attacks on Saudi-backed forces in Yemen
item.description: Yemen's Houthi rebels launch new attacks on Saudi-backed troops, state media reports, as Senator Cruz urges U.S. to seek regime change.

item.title: Thailand school shooting leaves six dead, many injured
item.description: At least six killed and over a dozen wounded in a shooting at a high school on the outskirts of Bangkok.

item.title: Surveillance video captures golf cart arson in Washington
item.description: A witness said the suspect claimed to be with the fire department.

item.title: Thailand shooting: Six dead after suspect kills grandparents
item.description: A teenager described as troubled by a classmate killed his grandparents before shooting at least six others at a school in Thailand, police say.
